chapter: From Pittsburgh to Maxine Sullivan: management and style
title: Her grandfathers and her maternal grandmother's family
summary: She doesn't remember her grandfathers; her uncle lives in Rankin and the family moved around.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Well, I knew that he was a barber but I don't remember ever having seen him. I think he died before I was born. The mere fact that the barber shop was still there and all the sons and daughters working in the barber shop was an indication that that was the family business.
And you don't remember his first name?
Okay, and the same on your paternal grandparent's side?
Yeah, I don't remember my grandfather on my mother's side at all.
Okay. Alright, you did mention your maternal grandmother, Anna French.
Now, her children lived in Rankin.
Well at least some of them.
She had two children. My uncle, my mother's brother lives in Rankin, Pennsylvania.
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
But my mother lived in Homestead.
That was my question. She actually was raised in Homestead?

Of course we moved around alot. We traveled around the area of Pittsburgh and up in the different coal mines, etcetra. I had a step-grandfather who was in the mines and also in the steel mills around Pittsburgh and in Youngstown, Ohio. And so my grand-mother got around. You see she, I was with her most of the time.
